caption: The drawing is a technical illustration done in black ink on a beige or yellowed paper background. It depicts a furniture design, likely a sideboard or console table, shown from the front and the side. The front view shows three upper rectangular drawers, with the middle drawer labeled "CARVED PANEL" and small knobs drawn as dots on all drawers. The table is supported by four cabriole-style legs, which curve outward and end with a decorative, almost circular foot. Beneath the drawers, there is a decorative apron with intricate scrollwork. The side view shows one of the legs and its profile, emphasizing the same ornamental style. Dimensions are marked, with the width stated as 47 1/4 inches and the depth as 27 inches. Below the main drawings are three small, horizontal decorative motifs numbered 1, 2, and 4, showing geometric and scroll patterns, as well as one vertical decorative panel marked as 3, filled with scrolling acanthus leaves and floral elements. The drawing's scale is indicated as 1/8" to 1'. The name "Isadore Goldberg" is signed in the lower right corner. There are faint smudges and stains on the drawing, and registration marks can be seen at the corners.
title: Highboy
